news.Title: 攻智慧感測應用 智原推聯電14奈米矽驗證IP解決方案
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-14 10:51:34 新聞中心 發佈

ASIC設計服務暨IP研發廠商智原(3035)昨(13)日推出MIPI C/D Combo PHY IP解決方案。這個在聯電(2303)14nm FinFET製程成功通過矽驗證的IP為視覺AI、機器視覺、智慧影像及其他需要高效能鏡頭與感測器的先進SoC應用，提供具有高成本效益的高速連接解決方案。

為滿足市場對智慧感測應用日益增長的需求，智原進一步擴展其在聯電14奈米FinFET平台的MIPI C/D Combo PHY IP產品組合。這次新推出的IP同時支援MIPI C-PHY v2.0，速度達到每trio 3.0 Gsps，以及D-PHY v2.5，每通道達4.5 Gbps，並提供可彈性擴充的配置，以滿足多元的頻寬需求。透過在兩種協定間共用腳位(pins)、數位邏輯、I/O緩衝區、PLLs及校準電路(calibration circuits)，這個Combo PHY架構縮減超過30%的IP晶粒面積，同時簡化高速資料傳輸所需的PCB佈局與電路板設計。

智原MIPI C/D Combo PHY IP的雙協定架構可透過C-PHY實現高效能影像傳輸，並利用D-PHY支援低功耗或待機運作。為提升高頻寬資料接收時的訊號穩定度，D-PHY接收器整合了高速去偏斜校準(de-skew calibration)技術。同時，內建自我測試功能(BIST)可支援兩種協定，簡化量產測試流程並降低測試成本。此外，這個IP支援交替低功耗模式(ALP)，提供低活動狀態下進一步降低能耗的選擇。

智原營運長林世欽表示：「邊緣AI與車用智慧感測帶動市場對高效能、低功耗影像傳輸連接技術的需求。智原已通過矽驗證的MIPI C/D Combo PHY IP具備更高的彈性與功耗效率，可支援新一代智慧感測方案。結合完整的聯電IP產品組合、基於Arm架構的SoC整合能力，及ASIC專業技術，智原能有效協助客戶簡化系統開發、減少測試工作與風險，並加速產品上市時程。」

Credo推1.6T光互連新品，擴大AI高速連接平台

M31擴大低功耗與高速IP，北美專案拚認列

news.Title: Global chip selloff deepens as AI worries, China competition weigh
news.Content:
Investing.com -- Shares of U.S. and European chipmakers fell Tuesday as a selloff in AI-exposed stocks deepened, pulling the broader technology sector lower amid concerns over the sustainability of AI investment and intensifying competition.

Before you buy NVIDIA: our AI model's stock picks are beating the market by 120%+. See the list now »

In U.S. premarket trading, Micron fell 2.3%, with Marvell Technology and SanDisk also sliding more than 2% by 04:28 ET (08:28 GMT). Western Digital dropped nearly 4%, and AMD and Broadcom each fell about 1%.

Not finding the right stocks? Our AI's list of investor-grade stock picks for October just dropped »

European chip names were hit harder. STMicroelectronics dipped 2.6%, Soitec and Infineon fell more than 1%, while chip-testing company Technoprobe slid 2.6%. Siltronic slipped 1.4%, Aixtron fell 1.9%, and ASM International lost 2.4%. Among equipment makers, ASML and BE Semiconductor shed over 1% each.

The moves followed a steep drop in Asian memory stocks. SK Hynix plunged 10%, Samsung Electronics lost 7.4%, and Tokyo-listed Kioxia fell as much as 13.3%. In Japan, SoftBank Group, which has significant exposure to the global AI industry, sank 8.5% and led a broader retreat in the country's semiconductor and electronics shares.

Those declines came after a weak session for tech on Wall Street, where the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.44% Monday. Micron slid 3.9% as investors weighed rising competition from China's ChangXin Memory Technologies. Over the weekend, CXMT said it had made significant progress on a new chip architecture designed to increase memory density by packing more data into a smaller space.

news.Title: ASIC族群9月營收走揚，世芯-KY、創意雙創高
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-13 10:18:49 黃立安 發佈

受惠AI需求及專案量產挹注，ASIC族群今年9月營收普遍走揚，世芯-KY(3661)、創意(3443)單月營收雙雙改寫歷史新高，智原(3035)亦創下16個月來高點，巨有科技(8227)、擷發科(7796)則呈現月增表現。觀察各家營運動能，世芯-KY受惠AI晶片量產規模擴大，創意則有CPU需求及車用專案放量支撐，智原持續受惠MCU、ASIC量產業務成長；巨有科技與擷發科則分別聚焦先進製程專案及AI軟體設計服務，力拚後續營運成長。

世芯-KY今年9月營收99.8億元，月增13.7%、年增496%，連續三個月改寫歷史新高；第三季營收261.9億元，同步創下單季新高，季增逾2倍、年增293.1%；累計前三季營收378.8億元，年增44.6%。公司指出，主要受惠量產產品增加，帶動營收規模持續擴大。

展望後續，法人預期世芯-KY的Trainium 3出貨動能可望延續至2027年上半年，若後續爭取到更多配額，則有機會進一步延續至下半年。至於採用2奈米製程的Trainium 4專案，公司先前指出，預計今年底前完成流片Tape-out，並以2027年底至2028年初量產為目標。

創意9月營收71.5億元，月增22.3%、年增97.8%，單月營收首度衝破70億元大關；第三季營收187.6億元，連二季改寫單季新高，季增35%，年增117.7%；累計今年前三季營收440.99億元，年增102.8%。

法人看好，創意受惠CPU需求強勁、中國車用專案放量，加上台積電(2330)產能支持，下半年營收可望優於上半年，並呈現逐季成長走勢。

智原9月營收14.18億元，月增19.8%、年增4.4%，創16個月來新高；第三季營收36.6億元，季增10.7%、年增13.2%，優於公司財測；累計前三季營收95.7億元，年減37.0%。智原先前指出，今年MCU及ASIC量產營收持續放大，可望填補遞延案件缺口，全年營收目標維持不變。其中，IP業務受惠晶圓代工廠產能利用率提升，以及12奈米平台相關需求增加，全年營收有望再創新高；NRE業務則仍須觀察大型專案認列時程。

巨有科技9月營收1.56億元，月增4.2%、年減23.8%；第三季營收4.36億元，季減28.7%、年減5.4%；累計前三季營收14.19億元，年增51.9%。公司持續推進先進製程布局，其中12奈米專案為今年主要成長動能，4奈米專案最快第四季開始認列收入，可望挹注後續營運。

擷發科9月營收407.1萬元，月增1.9%、年增137.1%，連續六個月成長；第三季營收1,167.2萬元，季增252.1%、年增119.0%；累計前三季營收1,773.3萬元，年減60.7%。擷發科表示，受惠AI軟體設計服務及ASIC專案陸續達成技術里程碑，先前遞延的營收逐步認列，推升第三季營運表現。其中，智慧車載AI軟硬體整合專案持續推進，下半年將以AI軟體設計服務為核心，搭配ASIC設計服務，強化軟硬體協同開發能力。

news.Title: Can NVTS' Alliance With Microchip Accelerate Its AI Power Growth?
news.Content:
Navitas Semiconductor NVTS is expanding its AI data center opportunity through its collaboration with Microchip Technology. The companies have developed an 800V DC-to-6V DC reference design for next-generation AI data center racks. The solution combines Microchip's digital power control and security technologies with NVTS' GaN power devices and is aligned with the Open Compute Project's 800V DC standard. The reference design includes hardware, software and design documentation to help data center developers reduce design time and bring new power systems to market faster.

The reference design uses NVTS' 650V GaNFast FETs and Microchip's dsPIC33AK digital signal controllers and TA100 CryptoAuthentication device. The system is designed to deliver up to 96% peak efficiency at full load, with a power density of 2,100 watts per cubic inch. It directly converts 800V DC to 6V DC by combining the 800V-to-50V and 50V-to-6V stages into a single converter. This approach is aimed at improving power conversion efficiency while supporting compact rack power systems.

The collaboration comes as AI data centers require higher power density and more efficient power delivery. Navitas has been focusing on this market as part of its broader shift toward high-power applications. In the second quarter of 2026, NVTS' high-power markets grew more than 50% year over year, while AI infrastructure is expected to account for more than one-third of total sales by the end of 2026. The company is also working on multiple AI data center programs tied to the transition toward 800V architectures.

The Microchip collaboration could help NVTS strengthen its position as more data center operators adopt 800V power systems. By combining NVTS' GaN technology with Microchip's digital control and security capabilities, the companies are offering customers a more complete solution for AI rack power. As 800V adoption expands, the new reference design could help NVTS gain additional design opportunities in the growing AI data center market.

How Competitors Fare Against NVTS

The company faces strong competition from ON Semiconductor ON and STMicroelectronics STM in the race to supply high-voltage solutions for AI data centers.

ON is expanding its presence in AI data center power as the industry moves toward 800V DC architectures. The company expects AI data center revenues to more than double in 2026, while silicon carbide revenues from AI data center applications are expected to grow nearly 60% year over year. The company expects its high-voltage revenues to accelerate as data centers adopt 800V DC distribution, increasing demand for its power solutions across the AI power tree.

Story Continues

STMicroelectronics is another semiconductor company gaining from rising AI data center power demand. The company reported 50% year-over-year growth in communication equipment and computer peripherals in the second quarter, supported by its AI-related customer programs. STM is already supplying microcontrollers, high-voltage power and analog products for the power stage of cloud AI systems and is building a pipeline for low-voltage power solutions. The company expects data center revenues to exceed $1 billion in 2026 and $2 billion in 2027 if current trends continue.

NVTS' Price Performance, Valuation & Estimates

Shares of Navitas Semiconductor have rallied 51% year to date compared with the Zacks Electronics – Semiconductors industry's growth of 31%.

NVTS YTD Price Return Performance

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

From a valuation standpoint, Navitas Semiconductor trades at a forward price-to-sales ratio of 43.71X, significantly higher than the industry's average of 4.91X. The Zacks Value Score of F suggests that NVTS stock is overvalued.

NVTS Forward 12-Month P/S Ratio

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for Navitas Semiconductor's 2026 bottom line is pegged at a loss of 14 cents per share. The estimates for 2026 loss per share have remained unchanged over the past 30 days.

news.Title: ASML vs. SIMO: Which Chip Stock Has More Growth Potential Today?
news.Content:
ASML Holding N.V. ASML and Silicon Motion Technology Corporation SIMO are two premier semiconductor firms focusing on advanced chip technologies and the broader semiconductor ecosystem. Both players are well-positioned to gain from growing demand for advanced computing, with ASML supplying the lithography equipment essential for manufacturing semiconductors and SIMO developing NAND flash controllers for SSDs and data storage applications.

ASML provides sophisticated hardware, software and systems that enable semiconductor manufacturers to produce increasingly smaller, faster and more energy-efficient chips. Its technologies are primarily used in the lithography stage of semiconductor manufacturing, in which complex circuit patterns are transferred onto silicon wafers.

Silicon Motion is a leading developer of microcontroller ICs for NAND flash storage devices. The semiconductor firm also designs, develops and markets high-performance, low-power semiconductor solutions for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and other customers.

Let us try to analyze some of the competitive strengths and weaknesses of the companies to understand who is in a better position to maximize gains from the emerging market trends.

The Case for ASML

Rapid expansion of AI infrastructure is one of ASML's most powerful growth catalysts. Training and inference workloads require increasingly powerful and energy-efficient processors, which are accelerating the transition toward smaller process nodes and more advanced memory technologies. The ongoing investments and continued progress in AI technologies are further boosting demand for both advanced Logic and Memory chips. Semiconductor manufacturers are accelerating capacity expansion plans, resulting in stronger commitments across ASML's product portfolio.

ASML's decision to materially increase manufacturing capacity provides another indication of strengthening demand visibility. Based on strong customer commitments, the company plans to increase its 2027 Low-NA EUV capacity by approximately 30% from its 2026 capacity of roughly 65 systems. It is also evaluating another roughly 30% capacity increase for 2028. A similar expansion is underway for immersion DUV. ASML plans to raise capacity by around 30% in 2027 from a 2026 level of roughly 130 systems and is evaluating another 30% increase for 2028. Capacity expansion suggests that customers are providing ASML with higher visibility into their multi-year fab and technology plans.

However, management attributes the current demand environment primarily to AI-related investment and the resulting need for more advanced Logic and Memory capacity. Although this has produced unusually long order visibility for ASML, it makes the growth profile increasingly dependent on customers maintaining those expansion plans. A slower pace of customer investment would therefore affect both system demand and utilization of the larger production footprint ASML is preparing, resulting in elevated operational risks.

Story Continues

The Case for SIMO

Silicon Motion has established itself as the leading merchant supplier of client SSD (solid state drive) controllers to module makers, including most market leaders in the United States, Taiwan and China. The company believes that it is well-equipped to adapt to industry changes as it has collaborated with flash vendors to develop proprietary controller technology to overcome the existing weakness of 3D NAND and outshine peers. Silicon Motion has commenced initial sales of 3D SSD controllers to flash partners. It expects this controller to be a significant SSD controller growth driver for the next year, as NAND Flash partners' 3D capacity expands.

Silicon Motion operates a fabless business model, focusing on chip design while outsourcing manufacturing to foundries like TSMC. Consequently, the company has a low capital investment requirement as it does not need expensive fabrication plants, enabling it to adopt advanced manufacturing nodes quickly, leading to higher margins compared to integrated manufacturers. This, in turn, enables the company to focus on innovation and product development rather than manufacturing complexity. The key growth drivers for SIMO include AI and high-performance computing, cloud data centers, automotive storage, smartphones and mobile devices. Each of these end markets is growing fast and offers lucrative growth potential. Over the past 10 years, the company has shipped more than 5 billion controllers cumulatively – more than any other company in the world. Silicon Motion ships more than 750 million NAND controllers on average every year.

However, sluggishness in the global economy is likely to weigh on the company's wireless and broader semiconductor market. The demand for PCs and smartphones in the end market continues to be soft as numerous suppliers are focusing on reducing their inventory levels. The near-term price fluctuation in the PC market remains a concern. Silicon Motion continues to acquire a large number of companies. While this improves revenue opportunities, business mix and profitability, it adds to integration risks. Moreover, the semiconductor industry is highly dynamic as it is prone to swift technological changes, stiff competition from evolving industry standards and declining average selling prices.

How Do Zacks Estimates Compare for ASML & SIMO?

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for ASML's 2026 sales implies year-over-year growth of 35.4%, while that for EPS indicates a surge of 56.9%. The EPS estimates have trended up 2.2% over the past 60 days.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for SIMO's 2026 sales indicates a year-over-year growth of 112.9%, while that for EPS suggests a rise of 214.4%. The EPS estimates have remained static over the past 60 days.

Price Performance & Valuation of ASML & SIMO

Over the past year, Silicon Motion has soared 194% compared with the industry's growth of 159.6%. ASML has gained 80.8% over the same period.

Silicon Motion looks more attractive than ASML from a valuation standpoint. Going by the price/sales ratio, ASML's shares currently trade at 11.79 forward sales, higher than 3.77 for SIMO.

ASML or SIMO: Which is a Better Pick?

ASML currently carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell), while SIMO carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here .

With a superior Zacks Rank and better fundamentals, Silicon Motion appears to be relatively better placed than ASML. Consequently, SIMO is a better investment option at the moment.

news.Title: AI Infrastructure Profit-Taking Weighs on STMicroelectronics N.V.’s (STM) Performance
news.Content:
Hardman Johnston Global Advisors, an investment management firm, issued its Q3 2026 investor letter for the "Hardman Johnston International Equity Developed Markets Strategy". The letter can be downloaded here . The strategy faced a challenging third quarter, underperforming its benchmark with a return of -5.51% versus +0.81% for the MSCI EAFE Net Index. Consumer Staples and Utilities were the strongest contributors, while Information Technology and Health Care lagged. Japan provided strong regional support, unlike Europe, which detracted from overall performance. Despite short-term volatility and macro headwinds like inflation, rising interest rates, and high national debt, the firm believes disciplined stock selection continues to deliver long-term results. Resilient corporate earnings in the U.S. and Japan, paired with expanding demand across AI, energy infrastructure, and defense, support long-term growth opportunities. Also, check the strategy's top five holdings to see its best picks in 2026.

In its Q3 2026 investor letter, Hardman Johnston International Equity Developed Markets Strategy highlighted STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE: STM ). STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM), a leading semiconductor designer and manufacturer, detracted from performance during the quarter. On October 09, 2026, STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM) closed at $52.06 per share. STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM) retuned 8.96% over the past month, while its shares gained 80.76% over the past 52 weeks. STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM) has a market capitalization of $46.63 billion, with a 52-week trading range between $21.11 and $81.42.

Hardman Johnston International Equity Developed Markets Strategy stated the following regarding STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM) in its Q3 2026 investor letter:

"On the negative side, Information Technology and Health Care were the largest sector detractors from relative performance. Within Information Technology, STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM) and Infineon Technologies AG were the largest detractors. STMicroelectronics and Infineon were hurt by a broader unwind in AI infrastructure related stocks, which reflected valuation concerns and profit-taking rather than weaker fundamentals. Pressure increased when leading A.I. companies called for a slowdown over safety concerns. Consistent with our risk management discipline, we had trimmed semiconductor exposure multiple times during the year. STMicroelectronics also faced a softer gross-margin outlook, which we view as a reset in the pace of margin recovery rather than a decline in long-term earnings power, with the company's silicon photonics offering and a cyclical recovery in automotive and industrial semiconductor demand remaining important potential growth drivers."

news.Title: ASML's Q3 Earnings Coming Up: How Should You Play the Stock?
news.Content:
ASML Holding N.V. ASML is scheduled to report third-quarter fiscal 2026 earnings on Oct. 14, before market open. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for sales and earnings is pegged at $13.18 billion and $12.47 per share, respectively. Earnings estimates for ASML in 2026 and 2027 have declined over the past 60 days.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

Earnings Surprise History

The leading advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment firm has delivered a four-quarter earnings surprise of 3.91%, on average.

Earnings Whispers

Our proven model predicts a likely earnings beat for ASML for the third quarter. The combination of a positive Earnings ESP and a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), 2 (Buy), or 3 (Hold) increases the chances of an earnings beat. That is exactly the case here.

You can uncover the best stocks to buy or sell before they're reported with our Earnings ESP Filter.

ASML currently has an ESP of +4.49% with a Zacks Rank #3. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank stocks here .

Factors Shaping Upcoming Results

During the quarter, ASML announced a collaboration with Xanadu Quantum Technologies Limited to advance lithography processes for Xanadu's photonic quantum hardware. The partnership is aimed at exploring how advanced lithography innovations can reduce optical losses in quantum computing chips and support progress toward utility-scale quantum computing. The companies will evaluate lithography-enabled process approaches designed to improve patterning control and enable lower-loss photonic structures.

ASML and Samsung Electronics expanded their long-standing strategic partnership, strengthening cooperation in High-NA EUV lithography and advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies. The collaboration is intended to accelerate the development and deployment of next-generation technologies capable of meeting the rising performance and efficiency requirements of semiconductor manufacturing, particularly amid growing demand related to AI applications.

In the quarter under review, ASML announced that it has begun construction of its second major industrial campus in the Brainport region of the Netherlands. The company, along with its partners, marked the occasion with a groundbreaking ceremony at Brainport Industries Campus North. The multi-phase development is expected to eventually cover approximately 350,000 square meters and accommodate up to 20,000 workplaces. The new campus is designed to keep key activities closely integrated within the Brainport region while strengthening ASML's broader global operational network.

ASML announced that it has extended its collaboration with Intel. ASML's High NA EUV lithography has helped Intel Foundry in Panther Lake production. The companies are collaborating to develop increasingly complex AI products to support future High NA EUV scaling. This will bring together the lithography ecosystem around larger-format masks. These developments are expected to have a favorable impact on ASML's fiscal third-quarter results.

Story Continues

Price Performance

ASML has gained a stellar 89.1% over the past year compared with the sector's growth of 32.1%. It has outperformed peers like Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. AEIS but lagged Silicon Motion Technology Corporation SIMO. While AEIS has gained 67.6%, SIMO has soared 205.3% over this period.

Key Valuation Metric

From a valuation standpoint, ASML appears to be trading at a premium relative to the industry. The company trades at a forward price-to-sales ratio of 11.74, higher than the industry average of 11.11.

Investment Considerations

ASML's growth outlook remains closely tied to the growing demand for advanced semiconductor capacity backed by continued expansion of AI infrastructure. Growing demand for smaller, more advanced chips and high-performance memory is requiring chipmakers to use more sophisticated lithography technology, driving growth across ASML's portfolio. Management expects 2026 advanced foundry Logic revenues to rise about 25%, while Memory revenue is projected to increase 75%. EUV revenues are expected to grow roughly 45%, with DUV, metrology and inspection revenue projected to increase about 25%.

The company is also benefiting from recurring service revenues and software-led upgrades that enable customers to improve productivity without purchasing entirely new systems. ASML also has relatively strong demand visibility, with customer commitments extending into 2027 and 2028.

However, ASML remains exposed to several risks. Its growth increasingly depends on semiconductor manufacturers maintaining elevated capital spending, particularly on AI-related capacity. China is expected to account for roughly 20% of 2026 sales, making the company vulnerable to changes in export restrictions.

End Note

As a leading provider of holistic lithography solutions, ASML is benefiting from a demand cycle that extends beyond a single node transition. ASML offers strong long-term growth potential, backed by AI-driven semiconductor demand and its leadership in lithography, but policy risks and execution challenges remain. Premium valuation leaves very little room for execution-related risks. ASML carries a Zacks Rank #3 with a VGM Style Score of B, a moderately favorable combination rather than a strong directional signal. Long-term investors could hold on to the stock, but new investors should wait for a better entry point.
